_original_lore: The Kindleheart Demon is a Inferno Demonlord

name: 燃心恶魔 (小头目)

source: The Kindleheart Demon is a Inferno Demonlord
Miniboss that very rarely spawns after killing a

loreParagraphs.translation: 燃心恶魔是地狱恶魔领主小首领,在地狱恶魔领主 IV 阶任务中击杀烈焰人后有极低概率生成.
